risks: NoiseTruth.surviving_ids() in bench/noise.py returns range(original_row_count) - dropped_ids, which assumes input ids are exactly 0..N-1. When the pipeline reads bronze written by the main() CLI, synthetic.py's legacy add_noise has already dropped 3% and duplicated 0.5% of rows, so bronze __truth_id values are a sparse subset of range(M) with M > N. A downstream inject_noise call in prepare_silver will then set original_row_count to the sparse count N and produce an incorrect surviving set. T-002 round-trip uses the new in-memory generate_synthetic (contiguous ids), so it does not trip this. T-003 or a T-001 follow-up must fix surviving_ids to compute original_ids_set - dropped_ids. OUT OF SCOPE for T-002 (Do-Not-Touch list).

Architecture.md says '__truth_id added inside make_flight before concat'; the implementation assigns after concat in both generate_synthetic and main(). Result is identical (monotonic int64 across the full set) and simpler. Call out for data-engineer review if the exact placement matters.

The legacy add_noise in synthetic.py still runs before bronze write in main(). The architecture figure in architecture.md implies synthetic emits a clean frame that inject_noise then noises. T-002 scope explicitly said 'don't change existing column semantics' so add_noise is untouched. The pipeline therefore applies noise twice on the matrix path (bronze-time add_noise plus bench.noise.inject_noise). Flag for product-owner/data-engineer alignment.

etl4/ingest/synthetic.py gained a top-of-file sys.path.insert so subprocess-style invocations (test_pipeline.py conftest runs the module as a script) can resolve etl4.bench.noise. This mirrors the pattern in etl4/run_pipeline.py and etl4/vault/run_vault.py. The in-process pytest path also works via the tests/conftest.py path insert.

evidence.notes: Three changes landed: (a) etl4/ingest/synthetic.py now imports TRUTH_ID from etl4.bench.noise, assigns __truth_id as a monotonic int64 arange after per-hour concat (preserving the ADR invariant 'monotonic across the generated set'), and includes it in the bronze parquet column list; a new generate_synthetic(n_rows, seed) returns a bronze-shaped in-memory DataFrame with contiguous ids. Added top-of-file sys.path.insert so the module remains runnable as `python etl4/ingest/synthetic.py ...` (what tests/conftest invokes via subprocess). (b) etl4/clean/clean.py gained a conditional stable-sort by DEDUP_KEYS + ['__truth_id'] before drop_duplicates so the lower __truth_id wins deterministically on dupe collisions; the sort runs only when the column is present, keeping real-data (s3, rest) paths byte-identical. (c) artifacts/t002_roundtrip.py exercises project_raw, clean, event_time_order, kinematic_features, segment_time_gap, segment_kinematic, smooth_and_segment; each stage asserts TRUTH_ID present, non-null, surviving-set membership, and (post-dedup) uniqueness; a merge-to-ground-truth on __truth_id with validate='m:1' confirms every output row's (icao24, time) matches its ground-truth pair (noise only perturbs lat/lon). No apply, no iterrows, no per-row iloc; icao24 stays string dtype.
